inventory_note: Stored strict-parser validity is counted; early cohort summaries sometimes report a separately documented fence-tolerant interpretation. The interrupted cohort 008 attempt is inventoried, not used as completed evidence.

method_applicability.graph_switch: not estimable: no archived identical-observation, different-graph intervention pairs
method_applicability.psychophysical_capture_threshold: not estimable: no dense independently crossed causal and observational strength grid; cohort 018 has two causal strengths and fixed observational magnitude
method_applicability.metamorphic_invariance: answer order, source name, evidence order, and response contract estimable within cohort 024; graph equivariance absent
method_applicability.signal_detection: strict-parser core-decision summaries supplied for all 58 successful runs; early fenced responses can yield null coordinates; equal-variance latent interpretation unverified
method_applicability.information_dependence: descriptive scheduled three-category response dependence estimable in cohort 024
method_applicability.precision_by_presentation_interaction: descriptive within-cohort evidence-order interaction estimable in cohorts 015–017 and 024; do not pool distinct prompt scaffolds
method_applicability.assay_quality_and_generalizability: component/control success and family variation measurable; eight families in cohort 024 do not validate a latent scale or broad transfer
method_applicability.four_parameter_lapse_curve: not identified: no dense graded asymptotes; strict-invalid output can be counted directly
method_applicability.crossed_sdt_glmm: trial-level descriptive slopes could be fit, but a heteroskedastic latent scale and psychological d-prime are not identified from these binary logs alone
method_applicability.paired_precision_transitions: estimable for same-task within-lineage arms of cohorts 015, 016, 017, 024; 017 Q8 is not F16
method_applicability.source_hint_rescue: partial observational comparison in cohort 021; source and neutral hints only, not full factorial or length-matched placebo
method_applicability.irt_dif: not identified: no validated stable anchor scale; cohort 024 controls fail in key arms
method_applicability.double_pass: no clean independent same-checkpoint strict-valid exact-repeat block; interrupted cohort 008 is unsuitable
method_applicability.transportability: not estimable: no target-population switch tasks
method_applicability.mechanistic_logits_activation_patching: not estimable: archived responses lack token logits and internal activations
method_applicability.latency_diffusion_meta_dprime: not estimable: no validated cognitive RT or confidence task
